title: Mota extension registry
description: The index Mota Editor reads to browse and install extensions. scripts/validate.mjs enforces this and more (it also cross-checks every entry against the extension's own mota-extension.json).

version.description: Registry format version. Bumped only for a breaking change; readers must ignore unknown fields so the format can grow additively.

extensions.description: Sorted by id, one entry per extension.

id.description: The extension id — equals the manifest name and the folder it installs into.

description.description: One line, shown in the browse list. Say what it does, not that it is awesome.

permissions.description: Copied from the manifest so the list can be browsed and filtered. Advisory only — Mota re-reads the real manifest at install time and asks for consent from that.

commands.description: Slash command names contributed, without the leading slash.

runtime.description: What has to be on PATH to run it. "none" means pure data — no process at all.

setup.description: Anything the user must do after installing — an API key, a sign-in. Omit when there is nothing.

pathSource.description: Hosted in this repository: the folder is reviewed as a diff and installed by copying it.

gitSource.description: Hosted in the author's own repository: installed by a shallow clone. The repository root must be the extension folder (mota-extension.json at the top).

ref.description: Branch or tag. Defaults to the repository's default branch.
